name: exercise ball seated hamstring stretch
description: Seated on a stability ball with one leg extended, you lean forward to stretch the back of the thigh.
instructions: Sit upright on a stable ball with both feet on the floor.
Extend one leg forward with the heel on the floor and toes pointing up.
Keep your back long and hinge forward from the hips until you feel a stretch behind the extended thigh.
Hold without bouncing, sit upright, and switch legs.
